result.topic_en: Computation of the constants for an orbit determination from three observations (Gauss's method), using ratios of triangles to sectors, followed by formulas for auxiliary angles and a spherical-trigonometry relation.
result.transcription:
61 [-51-] 61
Litt: H.

Berechnet die Constanten
$A\sin(\alpha'-\alpha) - B\sin(\alpha''-\alpha) = \Sigma\sin(V-\alpha)$
$A''\sin(\alpha'-\alpha) - B''\sin(\alpha''-\alpha) = \Sigma\sin(V''-\alpha'')$ [?]

$\theta\sin(\alpha''-\alpha') - \theta'\sin(\alpha''-\alpha) + \theta''\sin(\alpha'-\alpha) = \Sigma$
$D(\theta\sin(V-\alpha'') - \theta''\sin(V-\alpha)) = A$ \quad $D(\theta\sin(V-\alpha') - \theta'\sin(V-\alpha)) = B$
$D'(\theta\sin(V'-\alpha'') - \theta''\sin(V'-\alpha)) = A'$
$D''(\theta\sin(V''-\alpha'') - \theta''\sin(V''-\alpha)) = A''$ \quad $D''(\theta\sin(V''-\alpha'') - \theta''\sin(V''-\alpha')) = B''$

Bezeichnet durch k, k'' die Quotienten aus der Division des letzten und ersten Dreiecks durch die correspondirenden Ausschnitte. und durch M [-die Grösse-] $\frac{rr''}{rr''}\cdot\frac{kk''}{\cos\frac12(V'-V)\cos\frac12(V''-V)\cos\frac12(V''-V')}$ die so wie
$\frac{k}{k''}$ sehr nahe $=1$ sein wird. Alsdann ist

1/ [-$\delta'\Sigma\delta''$-] $\Sigma\delta'' = A' + \frac{(t'-t)k''A'' + (t''-t')kA}{(t'-t)k'' + (t''-t')k}\left\{1 + \frac{M(V'-V)(V''-V')}{2r'^3}\right\}$

2/ $(\delta' B + \theta DD'\sin(V'-V)) = \frac{(t''-t)k''}{(t'-t)k''+(t''-t')k}(\delta''A + \theta DD''\sin(V''-V))\left\{1 + \frac{M(V'-V)(V''-V')}{2r'^3}\right\}$

3/ $\delta' B'' + \theta''D'D''\sin(V''-V') = \frac{(t''-t')k}{(t'-t)k''+(t''-t')k}(\delta A + \theta''DD''\sin(V''-V))\left\{1 + \frac{M(V'-V)(V''-V')}{2r'^3}\right\}$

4/ $\delta'\sin(\alpha''-\alpha') + D'\sin(V'-\alpha'') = \frac{1 + \frac{M(V'-V)(V''-V')}{2r'^3}}{(t'-t)k''+(t''-t')k}\left\{\begin{array}{l} k(t''-t')\{\delta\sin(\alpha''-\alpha) + D\sin(V-\alpha'')\} \\ + k''(t'-t)D''\sin(V''-\alpha'')\end{array}\right\}$

$\tang\omega = \frac{\theta}{\sin(V-\alpha)}$

$\frac{\delta\theta}{\sin\omega(R - \delta\cos(V-\alpha))} = \tang\eta$

$r\sin\eta = \frac{\delta\theta}{\sin\omega}$

$\sin\frac12\Delta^2 = V\{\sin\frac12\lambda^2\sin\{\frac12(\eta+\eta')-A\}^2 + \cos\frac12\lambda^2\sin\{\frac12(\eta'-\eta)+B\}^2\}$

$r\cos\eta = R - \delta\cos(V-\alpha)$
$r\sin\eta\sin\omega = \delta\theta$
$r\sin\eta\cos\omega = \delta\sin(V-\alpha)$

$\sin\frac12\lambda\sin A = \sin\frac12(V'-V)\sin\frac12(\omega'+\omega)$ \quad $\cos\frac12\lambda\sin B = \sin\frac12(V'-V)\cos\frac12(\omega'+\omega)$
$\sin\frac12\lambda\cos A = \cos\frac12(V'-V)\sin\frac12(\omega'-\omega)$ \quad $\cos\frac12\lambda\cos B = \cos\frac12(V'-V)\cos\frac12(\omega'-\omega)$

$\tang p\cos\omega = \tang V-\alpha$ [?] \quad $\cos p\cos\xi = \cos V-\alpha$ [?]
$\sin p\sin\omega = \sin\xi$ [?] \quad $\frac{\sin p}{\cos\xi}$

methods.what: Definition of the constants Sigma, A, B, A', A'', B'' from geocentric longitudes/latitudes and solar longitudes
Ratios of triangles to sectors k, k'' and auxiliary quantity M, with k/k'' approximately 1
methods.quote: Bezeichnet durch k, k'' die Quotienten aus der Division des letzten und ersten Dreiecks durch die correspondirenden Ausschnitte.

methods.what: Fundamental equation for the middle geocentric distance with correction factor 1 + M(V'-V)(V''-V')/(2r'^3)
Auxiliary angles omega and eta to obtain heliocentric radius r from geocentric distance
Gaussian-type formulas for angle between radius vectors via auxiliary lambda, A, B
